targetSelection.bossRule: All eight Boss IDs are included.
targetSelection.nonBossRule: One representative Normal, Elite, and MiniBoss from each of three family-region slices; never more than two definitions per rank/family-region.

representatives.selectionRationale: Wolf chain baseline: first legal member and repeatable Normal target.
Wolf chain Elite step; distinguishes the first higher-rank gate.
Wolf chain MiniBoss step with the authored howl/control mechanic.
Mine Normal baseline with periodic shell guard.
Mine Elite with frequent telegraphed rush.
Mine MiniBoss combining guard and rally mechanics.
Forest Normal baseline with periodic guard.
Forest Elite with a high-impact telegraphed heavy strike.
Forest MiniBoss with a recurring rally attack.

legalAcquisitionPaths.legacy: Buy the legacy sword/armor through the public trade action after blacksmith access; record actual gold paid. Fresh-save equipment is empty.
legalAcquisitionPaths.adventure-loot: Win a legal encounter through public encounter/combat actions; use the awarded owned ItemInstance and retain drop provenance.
legalAcquisitionPaths.crafted: Use public planCraft, satisfy recipe unlock/station/time/material/gold/stamina gates, then call public craft; retain recipe and input provenance.
legalAcquisitionPaths.boss-gear: Win a different Boss before the target first-kill fixture, then use that Boss reward; exclude the target Boss own drops from first-kill loadouts.
legalAcquisitionPaths.masterpiece: Complete a public masterpiece-enabled craft after meeting its Smithing, recipe, station and input requirements; require craftProvenance.masterpiece=true.

fixturePolicy.sourceItemReplay: A source item is generated once by a legal public acquisition checkpoint and copied unchanged into independent combat fixtures; no generator or reward-award helper is called directly.
fixturePolicy.level: Set through simulation.gainExp to the Phase7 relative band level.
fixturePolicy.worldGates: Region, season, hour, threat, safety, settlement stage, Wolf chain predecessors and Chief bossAlive are explicit controlled preconditions, then verified through canonical encounter option projections/public encounter actions.
fixturePolicy.startingGold: Controlled preparation wallet 1000; every gear/material transaction uses public actions and actual deltas are recorded. This endowment is not counted as fight reward.
fixturePolicy.companions: No companions; gross incoming damage is reconstructed from action-boundary HP and measured potion deltas.
